question: In which of the following years, 'Right to Information Act' was enacted?
solution:
The Correct answer is 2005.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​The Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005 was enacted by the Parliament and has come into force on 12 Oct, 2005.
 
• 2005 was a momentous year for the right to information (RTI) in India because it saw the enactment of a national right to information law.
 
• The Central Act was passed by the Indian Parliament on 12 May 2005.
 
• The Right to Information Act gives legal rights to people to seek information from the government and curb corruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Right to Information Act 2019 passed on July 15, 2019, modified the terms and conditions of service of the CIC and Information Commissioners at the central and states.
